mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-α inhibitor) may increase infection risk including parasitic infections, potentially reducing albendazole efficacy, while albendazole's hepatotoxicity could be exacerbated by adalimumab-related immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for treatment failure of parasitic infection and hepatic function; ensure appropriate infection screening before and during adalimumab therapy; consider alternative antiparasitic agents if feasible.
